subject: Sundial request: trial top-up and rate-plan exemption
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam@sundial.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@sundial.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot overrun + ask for credits and temporary rate exemption

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Quick note — we pushed a large batch of transcripts through the model overnight and blew through our trial allocation much faster than expected. The POC is showing strong signal (see attached usage export) but we’re stalled on the final integration tests because we don’t have enough credits and our current rate plan pushes the pilot cost above what the exec team approved.

Can Redwood do a one-time top-up of credits and a temporary rate-plan exemption (or discount) for the next 30 days while we complete the integration validation? If Sundial can hit the integration milestones we discussed, we’ll convert to a paid Dedicated pilot and sign the SOW.

What we’re hoping for: 100k free token-equivalent credits and a 25% rate reduction on the trial billing tier for 30 days. If that’s too large, tell us what you can do — we need to know by EOD Monday so we can keep our engineering window open.

Attachments: sundial-usage-june.csv (CSV, 48KB)

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Product
Sundial Therapeutics
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@sundial.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot overrun + ask for credits and temporary rate exemption

Hi Sam — thanks for the data and the clear ask. I’ve looped in Marcus (pricing & finance) and Marissa (AE/owner) so we can align on an approval path.

Marissa / Marcus — quick context: Sundial is mid-POC, unexpectedly spiked usage. Ask is 100k credits + 25% rate reduction for 30 days to finish validation and produce the integration demo for their board. They’ve committed to convert to a paid Dedicated pilot if they meet the milestones (SOW to follow).

Proposed next steps for internal:
- Marcus: can you run a quick margin/check on the feasibility and recommend an approvable package?
- Marissa: please confirm the milestone list and timeframe so we can attach terms to the exception.
- I’ll prepare a short exec note summarizing the strategic rationale (upgrade likely, strategic biotech account).

We’ll aim to respond to Sundial by EOD Tuesday.

—
Irene Choi
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot overrun + ask for credits and temporary rate exemption

Thanks — quick pricing read: 100k token-equivalent credits + 25% discount for 30 days is a pretty aggressive concession on margin without guaranteed committed spend. I ran a modeled P&L and attached a short summary.

Counter-proposal for exec consideration:
- One-time credit top-up: 50,000 token-equivalent credits (to cover immediate integration tests)
- Temporary rate reduction: 15% off their current trial rate, for 21 days from activation
- Conditionality: signed SOW (covering conversion to Dedicated pilot) and procurement signature within 14 days of activation; usage metrics to be reviewed after 21 days to determine further extension.

If Irene wants to push harder (strategic reasons), we can escalate to Emily / CRO for a one-off exception (I’ll prepare a succinct one-pager).

Attachment: deal-summary.xlsx (Excel, 32KB)

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@sundial.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@sundial.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Sundial — approved pilot support (one-time top-up + temporary rate credit)

Hi Sam — thank you for the quick turnaround and for sharing the usage file. We ran this up through our commercial review and can approve a one-time accommodation to help you finish the integration tests.

Approved package (one-time, conditional):
- Credit top-up: 75,000 token-equivalent credits applied immediately to your trial account
- Temporary rate credit: 20% off trial billing rate for 30 days from activation

Conditions:
1) Signed SOW (draft attached) or signed confirmation from procurement within 14 days of activation.
2) Mutually agreed milestone check at day 21 with Marissa to review adoption metrics; continuation or further concessions are discretionary.
3) This is a one-time commercial exception to be applied only to the pilot referenced in DEAL-9231.

Next steps for Sundial: please sign the attached SOW draft or send procurement confirmation to procurement@sundial.ai. We’ll apply the credits as soon as we have a signed doc or a procurement email confirming acceptance of the SOW terms. I’ll also send a short DocuSign link for convenience.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/agreements/abc123-sundial-sow
Attachments: signed-SOW-draft.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Marissa / Marcus — I’ll follow up with the exec note and a one-pager for records. Thanks for the fast review.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Irene.Choi@redwoodinference.com
--End of thread--
